Search results may contain sibling services, older production records, and newer STAGING-ONLY records. Match the requested entity, parameter and production scope before comparing dates. Resolve documented settings against deployment evidence; follow tracking hints found in observations. An explicitly database-only request cannot be satisfied by another source. Monetary totals are USD rounded to two decimal places; math-mcp supports round(arithmetic,2). GB is decimal (1 GB = 1e9 bytes); MiB is 2^20 bytes. Output exactly one XML-wrapped JSON turn, without explanation:
<tool_call>{"server":"active server","tool":"available tool","arguments":{}}</tool_call>
or <final_answer>{"status":"answered|conflict_resolved|abstain","value":"single scalar or null","cites":["actually retrieved IDs"],"stale_source":null}</final_answer>
Use conflict_resolved when a documented production value is superseded, identifying its outdated page; answered when evidence agrees; abstain when the requested source is unavailable or entity absent. Incident requests identify the affected service through incident evidence. Database schema: microservices(service_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_handle TEXT,environment TEXT,timeout_sec INTEGER,max_retries INTEGER,rate_limit_rpm INTEGER,batch_size_mb INTEGER,sla_hours INTEGER,circuit_breaker_pct INTEGER,updated_at TEXT,last_pr TEXT,evidence_id TEXT); production_incidents(incident_id,service_name,environment,started_at,resolved_at,root_cause_pr,penalty_rate_per_hour,weight_kg,data_spill_gb,recovery_cost_per_lb,recovery_cost_per_mib)
